findings.title: Wait for reminder cancellations before continuing the reschedule
findings.body: `forEach` does not await the async cancellation calls, so the handler proceeds to reschedule the booking and send reschedule notifications while the SendGrid cancellation request may still be in flight. If the old reminder is due during this interval, it can still be delivered after the booking has been rescheduled. Collect and await these promises before continuing.
